Subject: A note about the onboarding experiment

I wanted to share an update about the onboarding experiment that we began running. We began the experiment on July 6, and the experiment has now been running for six weeks. The result that we observed was that setup completion increased from 61% to 68%, which is an increase of seven percentage points. Support contacts did not change in a statistically meaningful way. My recommendation is that we keep the experiment running for two more weeks and then decide whether to expand it. Please send concerns by Tuesday.
